F1.claim: O commit salva alterações no repositório local.
F1.quote: Since Git is a distributed version control system, the difference is that commit will commit changes to your local repository, whereas push will push changes up to a remote repository.
F1.source_title: What are the differences between "git commit" and "git push"?
